title: Paraguay as a personal alternative
seoTitle: Moving to Paraguay: residency, housing and family | EXOBASIS
description: Plan Paraguay residency and a usable family base: entry, residence stages, Asunción, renting or buying, healthcare, banking and practical setup.
intro:
If you are considering moving to Paraguay, the important question is how you and your family would actually live there. You may want distance from the threat of war, a second home outside Europe, or a permanent change while you still control the timing. Paraguay offers a residence route worth examining, with personal application steps and a real need for local preparation.

EXOBASIS connects that route with the place you will stay, the people and services you will need, and access to your money. You can commission the whole preparation or a defined part of it, including finding and buying a home.

sections.title: What would Paraguay give you?
sections.body:
Paraguay is most useful when you want an option you can prepare before making a final move. A first visit can combine immigration work with a serious test of daily life. You can then decide whether to establish a reserve home, move the household, or use the country between longer periods elsewhere.

Those choices lead to different spending. A reserve needs reliable access and modest upkeep. A permanent move needs a school-year budget, continuing healthcare and an income arrangement that works from Paraguay. If your concern is war, repression or losing the freedom to leave your present country, begin the work while you can travel and obtain documents normally.

sections.title: A refuge you can reach, then return from
sections.body:
For a prepared refuge, work backwards from the front door. Where will you land, who will meet you, and can the entire household reach the property without depending on an untested border crossing? Asunción is a useful first base for appointments and onward travel. A remote plot creates a much longer chain of practical dependencies.

Paraguay is landlocked. Connecting flights and overland routes through neighbouring countries bring their own entry and transit rules. During a preparation visit, test the journey with luggage, children and any medication you will need. Keep an alternative arrival arrangement and accessible travel funds. The right time to establish those options is before a crisis disrupts transport.

A return journey also deserves preparation. Paraguayan-resident children under 18 travelling without both parents need the appropriate permission from the non-accompanying parent or parents to leave. Arrange the documents for your family before a hurried departure becomes necessary.

UK FCDO: Paraguay entry rules and travel with resident children

If war is the reason you are preparing, use the family destination and travel-planning guide to connect this country option with the timing and practicalities of leaving.

sections.title: Moving to Paraguay with your family
sections.body:
Living in Paraguay means building a Spanish-speaking daily life, even if your work and some schooling remain in English. Start with the week your family will actually have: school runs, shopping, medical appointments and a quiet place to work. A larger house further out can become an expensive choice in time and transport.

For an initial family assessment, use Asunción to compare neighbourhoods and services in person. Visit the school and the treating clinic before settling on a home. If you are drawn to a quieter location outside the city, repeat the same journeys from that address, including after heavy rain. This turns an appealing idea into a decision your household can live with.

sections.title: Using Paraguay between stays elsewhere
sections.body:
A second residence needs a calendar as well as a key. Paraguay’s migration authority says it may cancel temporary residence after more than one continuous year of unjustified absence, and permanent residence after more than three continuous years. It describes prior authorisation as the route for protecting status before an extended absence.

For a reserve you intend to leave unused for long periods, that distinction matters. Plan visits around the status you actually hold, its expiry and any required immigration work. Give a trusted property contact clear instructions for inspections, bills and preparing the home before you return.

Paraguay migration authority: absence and possible cancellation of residence, 8 April 2026

sections.title: Paraguay residency: entry, temporary status and the next step
sections.body:
For visitors travelling on a full British citizen passport, UK guidance states that no visit visa is needed and permission is normally given for 90 days on arrival. Have your passport stamped at the point of entry, including at a land border. Keep that evidence: the residence application requires proof of lawful entry. Paraguay’s official 2026 visa table lists a visa requirement for British nationals seeking an extension, residence or paid activity. If you are moving from the UK to Paraguay, arrange the relevant consular visa step before the residence-application trip. Emirati nationals have the same distinction in the table between a visa-free tourist visit and these other purposes. If you live in the UAE, eligibility follows your passport, not your Emirates residence card.

Under the regular route in Law 6984/2022, temporary residence is granted for up to two years, renewable for the same period, and is the usual prerequisite for permanent residence. The application is personal and in person. During processing, the authority describes a provisional status, residente precario, permitting departure and re-entry, study and work for its duration. A Paraguayan identity card, the cédula, is a separate document with the same validity period as the temporary residence.

For the later change to permanent residence, the normal application window is the three months before the temporary card expires. The authority requires evidence of actual income or available resources and identifies a ten-year renewal cycle for the permanent-residence card. Put that later application on your calendar from the start.

Paraguay migration authority: 2026 visa table, United Kingdom and UAE

Paraguay migration authority: changing from temporary to permanent residence

We organise the relevant route for each person, including any family or other category that changes the sequence. That gives you the appointments and evidence to prepare before booking a visit, and the later steps to keep in view after the first application.

sections.title: Where to live, what to rent and how to buy
sections.body:
Start with Asunción, then test the alternatives

Asunción is a practical place to combine residence appointments, bilingual schooling and access to major-city private healthcare. Villa Morra is one area to investigate: the American School of Asunción is based there. Choose a home by the actual school and clinic journey, the street after heavy rain and the building’s water, power and internet arrangements.

Paraguay’s road conditions make distance important. The FCDO reports flooding even on major paved roads and rural roads that can become impassable in the rainy season. A countryside property needs an all-weather access check, water and power arrangements, and a realistic route to treatment. Security also changes by address: assess lighting, access control and transport rather than treating a whole city as uniformly safe.

UK FCDO: road conditions, flooding and security in Paraguay

Rent first if the location is still a decision

A furnished short stay lets you attend appointments and test a neighbourhood without furnishing a permanent home immediately. For a longer tenancy, agree the term, payment currency, included building charges, repairs, notice and inventory in writing. Establish early what the landlord will accept as financial evidence.

Local property firm Zuba distinguishes the cash deposit from a personal guarantor or other rental security. Its guidance makes the deposit amount and refund terms a matter for the agreement. A newly arrived household should therefore settle the guarantee arrangement before relying on a particular property. Record the condition at handover and who may enter to deal with a leak or power problem while you are away.

Zuba: rental deposits, guarantees and handover practice

Buying property in Paraguay

Paraguay’s investment law gives foreign investors the same legal guarantees and obligations as domestic investors, subject to statutory restrictions. A specific restriction applies to rural land within the 50-kilometre border security zone: nationals originating from neighbouring countries, and entities majority-owned by them, require authorisation by executive decree unless a statutory exception applies. Under article 3 as amended by Law 2647, the restriction does not apply to neighbouring-country nationals with permanent residence in Paraguay (radicación permanente). The amended article also protects duly proven rights acquired before the law took effect, inheritance rights of neighbouring-country nationals over property or companies in the zone, and charges established before the legislation took effect. This rule concerns the buyer, the land and its location; it is not a blanket ban on all foreign home buyers.

Before committing funds, appoint an independent Paraguayan escribano to establish the seller’s authority, registered title, mortgages or other encumbrances, cadastral identity and any special restrictions. The plot you visit, the cadastral description and the registered property must correspond. A building inspection and confirmation of access, services and permitted use answer different questions from the title search.

For a purchase assignment, EXOBASIS develops the location and property brief, organises the search and viewings, commissions independent title and purchase checks, and coordinates the contract, completion and handover. The purchase budget separates the price from notarial and registration work, applicable taxes, technical checks and any agreed agency charge. You receive the property-specific costs before deciding to proceed.

For a home kept in reserve, include key custody, regular inspections, utilities and arrival preparation in the assignment. Ownership is useful when the home can be opened and occupied when you need it.

sections.title: Schools, treatment and support close to home
sections.body:
A school your child can continue in

The American School of Asunción offers a bilingual programme from early childhood through college preparation, following US and Paraguayan educational standards. It is a concrete English/Spanish option to investigate, rather than a reason to assume that any neighbourhood has equivalent provision. Obtain the admissions requirements, year placement, fees and a decision on a place before making the school central to your housing choice.

Bring recent reports, identity and family records and details of language or learning support. If one parent will remain elsewhere, residence consent and permission for later travel deserve the same attention as admission. We connect those tasks with the home search and your planned arrival.

American School of Asunción: bilingual programme and location

Prepare the move around your children and family

Arrange treatment and the means to pay

The FCDO reports good private facilities in major cities, while provision elsewhere may be much more limited. It also says hospitals and doctors expect immediate payment and that some medicines may be unavailable. Insurance coverage, a clinic able to treat you and money you can use at reception are therefore three separate preparations.

For recurring treatment, arrange a clinical handover, confirm the medicine and dose locally, and establish appointment and payment arrangements. Include evacuation or repatriation cover where needed. Dengue, chikungunya and periods of poor air quality belong in the household’s health preparation. For an older relative, organise the actual help required at home and transport to treatment before choosing a more isolated property.

UK FCDO: healthcare, medicine availability and health risks in Paraguay

sections.title: Banking and work: make the money usable
sections.body:
Build the arrival budget around rent or purchase costs, schooling, treatment, transport and a reserve for another trip. Keep more than one working payment method, test a small transfer and check that you can access banking security codes from abroad. A second country is a weak contingency if all available money still depends on one card or one blocked account.

Local banks set their own account requirements. For example, Sudameris lists a Paraguayan cédula, RUC tax identification and proof of income for its current account, together with an opening deposit and account conditions. Prepare identity, address, income and source-of-funds records for the bank you select. We organise the application work and resolve documentary requests with you.

Through our banking and liquidity preparation, EXOBASIS organises the paperwork for your selected account, including the cédula where required, income and source-of-funds evidence. Once the bank accepts the account, we coordinate the agreed access and payment tests for a usable second payment route for your household.

For remote work, the place where you perform the work matters. In a published ruling about an IT engineer, Paraguay’s tax authority distinguishes services performed abroad from the portion performed in Paraguay: the latter can fall within Paraguayan personal income tax even where the client is overseas. A foreign invoice or UK company does not make work carried out in Paraguay foreign-source by itself.

Have the local tax registration, invoicing and social-security position coordinated with obligations retained in the UK, UAE or another country before moving the work. The same preparation should establish whether your employer or business can continue the intended activity from the new address.

sections.title: Prepare the file before travelling
sections.body:
The temporary-residence list includes identity, proof of entry, birth and applicable civil-status certificates, criminal-record evidence and local police/INTERPOL checks. Foreign documents require the accepted apostille or legalisation and Spanish translation. The authority’s current rules distinguish the country of origin from countries where you have lived: for a UK citizen based in the UAE, that residence history changes which police evidence is needed.

For children, the parent or guardian arrangements are part of the application. Where one parent is absent, the official list specifies judicial or notarised authorisation for the child to live in Paraguay. Resolve that before arranging the family’s application visit.

EXOBASIS assembles the document sequence, organises the required translations and local work, and coordinates your personal appointments. We align document validity with travel rather than ordering every certificate at once. Preparation continues through follow-up and the next residence stage.

sections.title: Keep the home and the status ready
sections.body:
Put residence validity, absence periods, passport and cédula renewals on one calendar. Keep the migration authority’s contact and address records accurate, and plan the later permanent-residence work while the temporary status is current.

The property needs a separate routine: payment of bills, inspections after storms, checking water and air conditioning, and confirmation that keys and access still work. Before each arrival, arrange cleaning, basic supplies and any school or medical appointments. EXOBASIS can manage the follow-up and local tasks included in your ongoing assignment.

faq.question: Can I keep Paraguay residency while living mainly abroad?
faq.answer: The status and the length of absence matter. Paraguay’s migration authority may cancel temporary residence after more than one continuous year of unjustified absence, and permanent residence after more than three. It describes prior authorisation for longer absences. Plan visits, expiry dates and any authorisation around the status you actually hold.
